maria: Smoke checklist — p95 latency <200ms, error rate <0.1%, successful end-to-end QA check id=4092.

jason: I'll monitor traces + cost dashboard. Will set a query: `errors > 0.1% OR p95 > 250ms` to page.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created: rollout_id=rl-2026-1759998888, model=v3.2, initial=5%, cohorts=[NA-west,EU-central,AP-south]

roberto: Rollback tag: `model:v3.1-stable`. Rollback command: `deployctl rollback rl-2026-1759998888 --to model:v3.1-stable` — confirm permissions set for sam+kate.

sam: Permissions confirmed.
